question: Which earliest new degree falls can be certified on all 48 retained balanced n83 S3-chain inputs, and which remain bounded only?

claims.text: An exact binary first fall requires an explicit nonzero lower-degree polynomial combination plus exclusion of all lower degrees. Prime degree-four minors establish only a lower bound.
Last fall, regularity, ECDLP recovery and performance claims are out of scope for this certificate stage; exact unresolved prime cells remain part of the active user goal.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact finite-field computations, two pivot orders and fresh-process witness replay; no timing or statistical comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Not a separate target arm. Mandatory same-instrument selfcheck: xy+x and xy+y must yield a nonzero linear first fall at 2; tested before the target grid.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Not a separate target arm. Mandatory selfcheck duplicates, homogeneous quadratics and zero input row must report no fall through 2; malformed inputs and altered witnesses are rejected by unit tests.

seed_derivation.note: Original generator seed only; no new randomness.

instance_sampling.rule: All 48 previously generated public synthetic inputs, without selection by fall outcome

blinding.how: Fixed certificate rules; exact witness reconstruction, no statistical analysis

power.note: 16 inputs per family, one certificate stage each: 48 records. Exact computation, no inferential test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Small synthetic controls under 0.01s; target per-sample allowance is 750/48, not a measured n83 runtime.

primary.name: Earliest certified new degree fall
primary.definition: Least d with a nonzero f in V(F,d) of degree less than d not obtainable below d; exact value only with lower-degree exclusion and witness

secondary.name: Certified first-fall lower bound
secondary.definition: Excluded lower degrees plus one; does not establish an attained fall

stopping_rules.rule: Process all 48 inputs, emit one certificate each and replay each in a fresh process, then stop this stage
750s producer plus 10s grace within 900s job, 8Gi memory, no automatic retries

invalidation_rules: Input hash mismatch, lower-degree input unsupported by detector, failed controls or replay, malformed presentation or incomplete output prevents exact value admission

decision_rule.text: Report exact certificates and explicit lower bounds separately. The full user goal remains active when prime exact values are unresolved.
